body.subject: The #69 half corrected on cf316a44: the duplicate CLW5 re-pin dropped, the manifest arithmetic re-derived (380 to 358)

items.change: Applies the union rehearsal's finding to contribution-8eaf6ec8f5b182d858e489a851fae1a3 (accepted at seq 149622): the half's duplicate of the landed #569 CLW5 checkpoint re-pin is dropped from impl/test/coordination-ledger-writes.test.mjs — #569's line is kept verbatim, so the pin a3c56137 is carried exactly once, by #569. The half is rebased onto cf316a44 (master moved by d846922a + cf316a44 while the record was queued) and its manifest edit re-derived against the moved base: 380 rows at the new master minus the same 22 rows this half greens = 358 rows, set-exact, re-verified after the rebase. No other hunk changed; the #569 half on top is republished as its own correction.
items.evidence: At b20f685d: repl-realization-red 34 ok/0 not ok (its 22 removed pins all pass, measured per row); coordination-ledger-writes 6 ok/0 not ok with #569's CLW5 line standing and my duplicate comment gone; the manifest is set-exact master minus the 22.

carriedForward: This correction supersedes the branch/sha of contribution-8eaf6ec8f5b182d858e489a851fae1a3 for landing; the #59 half rides on this commit and is republished as contribution to follow on baton/digest-w7-target-69-59-recut.
